en: A vintage monochrome postcard showing a large stone hydroelectric power station building beside a fast‑flowing river or rapids. The long façade has repeated tall arched windows and smaller rectangular windows above, with water rushing past the base of the structure. Additional industrial buildings stand on the slope behind. Printed text at the upper right reads "Trollhättan, Kraftstationen."
